grammar_title: 短语复习(Review of Phrases):动词短语 · 介词搭配 · 固定搭配与习语
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 4 Review useful structures(短语复习)。三类:动词短语/短语动词(选正确小品词)、介词搭配(选正确介词)、固定搭配与习语。句子地道、志愿/慈善/分享主题,答案唯一(干扰项为同动词错小品词或错介词)。

points.point: 动词短语 / 短语动词(选正确的小品词:up/on/away/in/out/forward to 等)
points.overview: take up / carry on / give away / look forward to / set up / come up with / take part in 等短语动词;空格处选构成该短语的正确小品词(adverb/particle),干扰项是同一动词配错误小品词。

points.point: 介词搭配(be devoted to / be grateful for / in need of / on behalf of 等)
points.overview: 形容词、名词、动词与固定介词的搭配;空格处只填一个正确介词,干扰项为同结构里错误的介词。

points.point: 固定搭配与习语(make a difference / lend a hand / can't help doing 等)
points.overview: 整体意义固定的搭配与习语;空格处填使该习语成立的唯一正确词,干扰项为意义相近但搭配不地道的词。

questions.stem: After graduation, she decided to take ____ volunteer work in a poor village.
questions.explanation: take up sth = 开始从事;take up volunteer work 开始做志愿工作。

questions.stem: Even when funds were low, the charity carried ____ with its work in the bush.
questions.explanation: carry on = 继续(进行);其他小品词不与 carry 构成'继续'之意。

questions.stem: He gave ____ most of his old clothes to families in need.
questions.explanation: give away = 捐赠/赠送出去;give up 是放弃,不合句意。

questions.stem: The students look ____ to meeting the children at the hospital each year.
questions.explanation: look forward to = 期待;固定搭配,后接动名词。

questions.stem: A group of young people set ____ a charity to help the Roma in Budapest.
questions.explanation: set up = 创办/建立(一个组织)。

questions.stem: The volunteers came ____ with a clever plan to collect food for the poor.
questions.explanation: come up with = 想出(主意/计划)。

questions.stem: Every year his whole school takes ____ in a project to help the elderly.
questions.explanation: take part in = 参加;take part in a project 参加一个项目。

questions.stem: When her mother left for Africa, she found it hard to put ____ with the loneliness.
questions.explanation: put up with = 忍受;其余小品词不构成'忍受'之意。

questions.stem: The team handed ____ warm blankets to people at the refugee centre.
questions.explanation: hand out = 分发;hand in 是上交,不合句意。

questions.stem: Please do not throw ____ the leftover food; we can share it with others.
questions.explanation: throw away = 扔掉;throw away the leftovers 扔掉剩饭。

questions.stem: The young doctor signed ____ for a one-year medical mission overseas.
questions.explanation: sign up = 报名参加;sign up for a mission 报名参加任务。

questions.stem: We need more hands to help ____ at the animal shelter on Sundays.
questions.explanation: help out = 帮忙;help out at a shelter 在收容所帮忙。

questions.stem: The charity is calling ____ young people to give some of their free time.
questions.explanation: call on sb to do = 号召/呼吁某人做某事。

questions.stem: After hearing her mother's story, she came ____ to support the work fully.
questions.explanation: come round = (改变想法后)转而支持/被说服。

questions.stem: Volunteers must adapt ____ the simple conditions in the remote village.
questions.explanation: adapt to = 适应;adapt to the conditions 适应这些条件。

questions.stem: The school carried ____ a campaign to collect books for poor children.
questions.explanation: carry out = 实施/开展(活动/计划)。

questions.stem: She handed ____ her project report before joining the volunteer trip.
questions.explanation: hand in = 上交;此处指交报告,与 hand out(分发)相对。

questions.stem: The volunteers set ____ early in the morning to reach the mountain village.
questions.explanation: set off = 出发/动身;set off early 早早出发。

questions.stem: Don't give ____ even when the volunteer work feels really hard at first.
questions.explanation: give up = 放弃;此处指不要放弃,与 give away(捐出)区分。

questions.stem: The students take ____ donations of clothes and toys for the refugee centre.
questions.explanation: take in = 收下/接收;take in donations 接收捐赠物。

questions.stem: Her mother is devoted ____ helping people in distant African villages.
questions.explanation: be devoted to = 致力于/献身于;to 后接动名词。

questions.stem: The poor families were grateful ____ every parcel the volunteers brought.
questions.explanation: be grateful for sth = 因某事而感激。

questions.stem: The hospital was badly in need ____ doctors who could speak the local language.
questions.explanation: in need of = 需要;固定搭配用 of。

questions.stem: On ____ of the whole class, Tony thanked the children's hospital staff.
questions.explanation: on behalf of = 代表;固定名词搭配。

questions.stem: The volunteers expected nothing in ____ for their hard work.
questions.explanation: in return (for) = 作为回报;固定搭配。

questions.stem: Many people there live without things we are used ____ having every day.
questions.explanation: be used to (doing) = 习惯于;to 后接动名词。

questions.stem: She was upset that her mother left without asking ____ her opinion.
questions.explanation: ask for sth = 请求/征求(意见)。

questions.stem: The young doctors are proud ____ the work they do for the needy.
questions.explanation: be proud of = 为……感到自豪。

questions.stem: We should feel responsible ____ those who are less fortunate than us.
questions.explanation: be responsible for = 对……负责。

questions.stem: The medical team provided free treatment ____ patients in the rural villages.
questions.explanation: provide sth for sb = 为某人提供某物(provide medical treatment for patients)。

questions.stem: The charity is committed ____ building a better world for everyone.
questions.explanation: be committed to (doing) = 致力于;to 后接动名词。

questions.stem: These young people are willing to care ____ strangers in need of help.
questions.explanation: care for sb = 关心/照顾某人。

questions.stem: Volunteers are often faced ____ very difficult living conditions abroad.
questions.explanation: be faced with = 面临/面对;固定搭配用 with。

questions.stem: The local people benefit greatly ____ the new cardiac hospital.
questions.explanation: benefit from = 从……中受益。

questions.stem: Her team contributed ____ saving many lives with a new malaria treatment.
questions.explanation: contribute to (doing) = 有助于/为……作贡献;to 后接动名词。

questions.stem: These volunteers are ready to share their skills ____ needy communities.
questions.explanation: share sth with sb = 与某人分享某物。

questions.stem: He finally became supportive ____ his mother's work in Tanzania.
questions.explanation: be supportive of = 支持(某人/某事)。

questions.stem: The programme depends ____ how well each volunteer performs.
questions.explanation: depend on = 取决于/依赖。

questions.stem: We must not take such everyday comforts ____ granted.
questions.explanation: take sth for granted = 视为理所当然;固定搭配用 for。

questions.stem: She is interested ____ joining the next volunteer trip to Ghana.
questions.explanation: be interested in (doing) = 对……感兴趣;in 后接动名词。

questions.stem: Even a small act of kindness can make a ____ to someone's life.
questions.explanation: make a difference = 起作用/带来改变;固定习语。

questions.stem: When the team was short of helpers, several neighbours lent a ____.
questions.explanation: lend a hand = 帮忙;固定习语。

questions.stem: Instead of paying her back, she chose to pay it ____ to others in need.
questions.explanation: pay it forward = 把善意传递给他人;固定说法。

questions.stem: Seeing the children so happy, she couldn't help ____ with joy.
questions.explanation: can't help doing = 禁不住做某事;后接动名词。

questions.stem: It's no use ____ about the problem; we should go out and help.
questions.explanation: it's no use doing = 做……没有用;后接动名词。

questions.stem: The volunteers worked hard to make the world a ____ place to live in.
questions.explanation: make … a better place = 让……变得更好;比较级 better 修饰 place。

questions.stem: She felt it was worth ____ a whole day with the village family.
questions.explanation: be worth doing = 值得做;后接动名词。

questions.stem: The charity always tries to give those in ____ a helping hand.
questions.explanation: those in need = 有需要的人;固定搭配用名词 need。

questions.stem: Many people went ____ medical treatment because it was too expensive.
questions.explanation: go without sth = 没有……也将就过/缺少;go without treatment 得不到治疗。

questions.stem: Helping others, she said, comes at the ____ of her list of proud things.
questions.explanation: at the top of the list = 在名单首位;固定搭配。

questions.stem: The volunteers gave their time and money, asking for nothing in ____.
questions.explanation: ask for nothing in return = 不求回报;固定习语。

questions.stem: Thanks to the new hospital, fewer patients have to go ____ for surgery.
questions.explanation: go abroad = 出国;此处指出国做手术。

questions.stem: After the meal, the family talked softly and made us feel at ____.
questions.explanation: make sb feel at home = 让某人感到自在;固定习语。

questions.stem: The young charity is breaking ____ in the way it helps poor communities.
questions.explanation: break new ground = 开创新局面/有所突破;固定习语。

questions.stem: When her mother returned, the family was finally ____ together again.
questions.explanation: be back together = 重新团聚;back 表'回到原来状态'。

questions.stem: Volunteering, she realised, is a way of giving ____ to society.
questions.explanation: give back (to society) = 回馈(社会);固定搭配。

questions.stem: We are ready to build a community with a ____ future for mankind.
questions.explanation: a shared future = 共同的未来;过去分词作定语。

questions.stem: No matter how small your effort is, it counts ____ a great deal.
questions.explanation: count for a great deal = 很有价值/很重要;固定搭配用 for。

questions.stem: The volunteers were determined to make the ____ of their short stay.
questions.explanation: make the most of = 充分利用;固定习语用 most。

questions.stem: Helping the disabled gave her a deep ____ of purpose in life.
questions.explanation: a sense of purpose = 使命感/目标感;固定搭配用 sense。
